title: WSL resources (Windows)
description: WSL VM resources managed by Sprut Desktop (SPRUT-CLIENT-SPECIFICATION 6.4, CR01-CR07; docs/wsl-resources.md). `wsl2` holds the MANAGED keys of the [wsl2] section of %USERPROFILE%\.wslconfig; member names are the literal .wslconfig key names and values are written exactly as given (`memory=8GB`). `sprut_distro.max_disk_size` is not a .wslconfig key: it is the maximum virtual disk size of the Sprut distribution only, applied with WSL tooling for that distribution. A member that is absent is left unchanged; removing a value happens only by restoring the backup (CR07). No member has a default in this contract: recommended values are open (spec Q15) and are never filled in silently. Rules: only managed keys change, every other key, section and comment is kept byte for byte; a backup is made before every change and the write is atomic; the global effect on all WSL2 distributions is shown before saving and replacing a value not set by Sprut needs confirmation (WSL_CONFIG_CONFLICT); new values take effect only after `wsl --shutdown`, which is a separate confirmed action (plan step restart_wsl) after a drain, and until then the state is WSL_RESTART_REQUIRED; after the restart the effective resources are read inside the Sprut distribution and used as the budget. Unknown members are rejected.

wslconfig_wsl2.description: Managed keys of the [wsl2] section of .wslconfig (CR01, CR02); at least one. memory: VM memory, a positive whole number of MB or GB. processors: logical processors, 1-1024. swap: swap file size, `0` disables swap, otherwise a positive whole number of MB or GB. networkingMode: only `nat` (mirrored is planned for node mode and stays refused until S2 decides Q14). No other .wslconfig key is managed.

disk_size.description: Maximum virtual disk size of the Sprut distribution: a positive whole number of GB or TB. Never applied to other distributions and never through .wslconfig defaultVhdSize (that key is global and not managed).
